en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a rural church with a tall central spire topped by a cross, stepped gables, pointed-arch windows and a round window on the transept. It stands in open fields under a cloudy sky. The margins around the image are filled with handwritten cursive text. Printed text below the image identifies the location as "Erikstad (Dalsland.)" and the left margin credits a Swedish photo publisher.
